title: seqeralabs/nf-proteindesign - RFdiffusion v3 samplesheet schema
description: Schema for validating samplesheets when --protein_design_tool=rfdiffusion_v3. Each row specifies a design YAML (contig + hotspots), structure files, and generation parameters.

sample_id.errorMessage: Sample ID must be alphanumeric with underscores or hyphens only

design_yaml.errorMessage: Design YAML must be a valid file path ending in .yaml or .yml

structure_files.errorMessage: Structure files must be a comma-separated list of PDB/CIF file paths

num_designs.errorMessage: Number of designs must be a positive integer

budget.errorMessage: Budget must be a positive integer (top-N designs to keep)

target_msa.errorMessage: Target MSA must be a valid file path to a pre-computed MSA file

target_sequence.errorMessage: Target sequence must be a valid file path to a FASTA file

target_template.errorMessage: Target template must be a valid file path to a PDB or CIF file
